dimension: 构图 + 景别 + 影调

en_prompt: The thriving wheat fields, with a composition divided by curved lines, transition from a distant view of the golden wheat waves to a close-up of the wheat grains, offering a rich variation in framing. The unified and warm colors bring joy to the viewer.
